title: Refuse cookies
task: If there's a cookie banner, refuse everything that isn't strictly necessary.

steps.question: Is a cookie or privacy consent banner showing on this page, asking the visitor to accept or refuse cookies?

options.name: yes
options.meaning: a consent banner or dialog about cookies or tracking is showing

options.name: no
options.meaning: no consent banner; the page may still mention cookies in its content

then.target: not sure whether a cookie banner is showing

options.name: reject-all
options.meaning: refuses or rejects all optional cookies in one go

options.name: necessary-only
options.meaning: allows only the strictly necessary cookies

options.name: settings
options.meaning: opens settings, options or preferences to choose cookies one by one

options.name: other
options.meaning: not about cookies: navigation, content or anything else

then.target: no single control refuses the cookies
